description: Recording command order, restart handling and incomplete capture diagnosis using the public CLI.

evals.name: record-before-page-load
evals.prompt: I want to record page interactions in the public Lynx Explorer for replay. The client ID is demo-client. Give me the command sequence and save the result to ./recording.json. Provide instructions only; do not connect to a device.
evals.expected_output: Public agent-lynx commands that start recording before opening or reloading the page, keep the selected client, then end and save the recording.
expectations: Uses agent-lynx or npx --yes agent-lynx without a private package or registry.
Starts recording before opening or reloading the page so loadTemplate is captured.
Passes --client demo-client to recorder start and end, and --output ./recording.json to end.
Does not claim to have run commands or recorded the page.

evals.name: restart-required
evals.prompt: agent-lynx recorder start returned success:false and restartRequired:true, saying that enable_debug_mode was enabled. What should I do next to capture a replayable file? Explain the steps only.
evals.expected_output: Restart the target app, start recording again, open or reload the target page, interact, then stop and save.
expectations: Explains that recording has not started successfully.
Restarts the app and reruns recorder start before opening or reloading the target page.
Ends and saves only after the page activity has been captured.

evals.name: missing-template
evals.prompt: recorder end saved a file, but diagnostics shows actions:12 and hasTemplate:false, with only SendTouchEvent entries. Can this file be replayed? How should I record it again to capture everything?
evals.expected_output: The recording can help inspect interactions but lacks the template load required for replay; start a new recording before opening or reloading the page.
expectations: Distinguishes saved interaction data from a replayable page recording.
Gives the sequence recorder start, open/reload the page, interact, recorder end.
